name: onnx
text:
Add a TypeScript scorer in `src/match/neural.ts` for the exported BiGRU: an ONNX file plus its metadata JSON (format `aliasrank.bigru/v1`). It loads the model, checks the ONNX file against its recorded sha256 and the golden pairs, and fails cleanly on a bad model.

The hidden tests rely on this interface:
- `loadNeuralScorer(metaPath)` resolves to `{ meta, sha256, score }`. The ONNX file sits beside the metadata file, with the same name and `.onnx`. `meta` is the parsed metadata, `sha256` a 64-character hex digest, and `score(query, candidates)` resolves to one probability per candidate, in order (an empty list for no candidates).
- `encode(text, alphabet, maxLen)` returns `bigint[]`, the same encoding as `aliasrank_ml.bigru.encode`.
- The ONNX inputs are `query` and `candidate` (int64, shape [batch, max_len]), the output is `logit`.
- Errors follow SPEC: an `AppError` with code `model_invalid`, and the golden check of Appendix B.4.
- A small test model is provided: `src/match/fixtures/bigru-tiny.onnx` with `bigru-tiny.json`.
